item.text:
Built the responsive course registration app in [index.html](/work/index.html), [styles.css](/work/styles.css), and [app.js](/work/app.js).

It includes four navigable pages, searchable and filterable course cards, an interactive registration form with a confirmation modal, and a registered courses table that updates credit totals. The layout adapts to mobile and includes accessibility features such as keyboard navigation, a skip link, labeled controls, live announcements, and reduced-motion support.

I didn’t run tests or browser verification.
